start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:keep-each-workshop-task-whole-and-a-small-index with store {\"where\": \"postgresql database example_shop on my own computer\", \"language\": \"SQL (PostgreSQL)\", \"credential_name\": \"example-shop-postgres-connection\"}, writes [{\"task_id\": \"t1\", \"tool_id\": \"bake-tool\", \"state\": \"done\", \"due_at\": null, \"seq\": 3, \"result\": \"12 loaves\"}] and questions {\"now\": \"2026-11-18T09:30:00Z\", \"tool_id\": \"bake-tool\", \"newest\": 10}."
no_lists_because: It names no list: each task and its index row are kept in the person's own store, in whatever form that store keeps things, and store says where and in which language.
instructions: 1. Keep the store's login in your vault under a name you choose, and say where the store is and how it is spoken to.
2. Say "Run workflow:keep-each-workshop-task-whole-and-a-small-index" with store, writes and questions. Send each write as the task's version as it is now, with its seq, never an older one by choice.

3. The first run makes the store's own objects once and proves them on the example writes: every write must be kept, repeated or refused as the intent says, and every answer must match, or the run stops and says which.
4. Every later run keeps the writes through those objects, then answers the questions from the index rows only. A question never reads a whole task unless it answers with that task.
